text: Yes. The logger records, for every game it watches: score, period, clock, time left, and the model's fair and Novig's ask for the best sides (every 20 s); every offer to the taker (rule, ask, fair, edge, second source, score and clock); every live bid wanted, pulled or passed over with the reason; plus the existing records of what the taker actually ordered and filled and what the light bids did. All of it uploads to GitHub with your bet history every 15 minutes. After the games end I grade each offer and bid against the final score (ESPN finals), and report whether they were good at the time (edge vs the outcome, by rule, sport, time left and lead) and what to tune. Ships next build (v0.114.27).
